## Action
 Elena observes the first successful archive with clinical satisfaction. The procedure works. The children will live.

## Gap
The moment of success feels hollow. She keeps thinking about the bodies — the ones they chose not to save.

## Choice
She buries the feeling and approves the next procedure. Momentum is all they have.

## Shift
Confidence begins to crack. The "positive" feeling of salvation is already mixing with doubt.
